changelog: v0.7.2: 1) Elimination of mock fallbacks: completely removed hardcoded mock stories and canned responses, ensuring only authentic model reasoning or clear, truthful communication; 2) Single Persistent Antigravity Session: persists cascade ID to active_cascade_id.txt in the session directory, guaranteeing that all conversation turns route to one continuous Cascade visible in the Antigravity UI across turns and server restarts; 3) Live Analysis Progress Indicator: real-time GET /api/chat/status polling and streaming progress updates showing concise HUD progress (e.g. 'Thinking with Antigravity...', 'Formulating answer...') during analysis; 4) Accelerated Language Server Discovery: fast HTTP liveness check and discovery caching, eliminating multi-second latency overhead.
